title: Owner-authorized successor packet admission gate
question: Does the current repository contain one source-authorized or explicitly owner-authorized, hash-pinned successor packet that fixes the PAH stationary-semigroup input and supplies every R-557 ordered-correlation field without editing immutable PAH-001?

fixed_scope.parent: Immutable strategy/pa-hyp/PAH-001-v1.json, its displayed functional, move/rate definitions, Gibbs state, carrier, external stochastic Markov time and registered j-before-n order.
fixed_scope.admission_object: A separately named successor packet may be considered only if its owner authority and all finite/common/asymptotic fields are hash-pinned before use.
fixed_scope.method: Inspect current owner-audit manifests and provenance; do not repeat finite witnesses, invent a carrier, or import a researcher hypothesis as PAH-001 source content.

required_fields: source or explicit successor owner authority and version hash
root multiplicity, duplicate-transition and invalid-move rules
root counting measure and a measure-compatible common realization
primary, independent, hostile and Lean replay manifests

decision_rule.admitted: All required fields are present, source or explicit successor authority is hash-pinned, parent attribution is not retroactive, and independent/hostile/Lean replay agrees.
decision_rule.hold: Any required field, authority, provenance or replay input is absent; record the exact missing field and do not manufacture it.
decision_rule.negative: A source-authorized packet contains an exact contradiction in one required field or replay, scoped only to that packet.

non_claims: No new function, rate, state, carrier, comparison map, counterterm or limit order is introduced.
No finite witness is repeated as a substitute for the packet.
No R-512 convergence, infinite-volume, continuum, physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion is made.
next_single_question: Can one owner-authorized, hash-pinned packet satisfy every required field without changing immutable PAH-001?
revisit_condition: Reopen the admission verdict only when a new owner-authorized packet or a parent PAH hash is present.
